trade.text: Cisneros said small businesses need relief from tariffs and introduced a bill allowing them to report concerns about tariff policies.
trade.quote: small businesses need relief from Trump’s chaotic use of tariffs

debt.text: Cisneros supported protecting and strengthening Medicare’s guaranteed benefits without cutting benefits or reducing access.
debt.quote: Protect and strengthen Medicare by safeguarding its guaranteed benefits

safety.text: Cisneros championed community violence-intervention programs intended to prevent violence and interrupt cycles of violence.
safety.quote: Representative Cisneros also championed numerous bills to address the boyfriend loophole and other measures to disarm domestic abusers and adequately fund important community violence intervention programs

guns.text: Cisneros supported universal background checks, longer background-check periods, and measures addressing domestic-abuser access to firearms.
guns.quote: He has always been a staunch supporter of the Bipartisan Background Checks Act

abortion.text: Cisneros voted against the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act and other bills described as restricting reproductive freedom or abortion coverage.
abortion.quote: A vote for reproductive freedom was against passage.

health.text: Cisneros proposed expanding and strengthening the Affordable Care Act, Medicaid, and Medicare while closing coverage gaps.
health.quote: improve access by closing coverage gaps for rural and underserved communities, strengthening Medicaid and Medicare

voting.text: Cisneros said he would champion voting rights and work to ensure everyone can participate in elections.
voting.quote: I’ll continue to champion voting rights, fight to ensure everyone can make their voices heard in our elections

tax.text: Ching supports maintaining low tax burdens and using revenue bills to avoid overburdening taxpayers.
tax.quote: Commits to using votes on revenue bills to ensure taxpayers are not overburdened.

schools.text: Ching supports school choice and empowering parents to decide which schools their children attend.
schools.quote: I support school choice, and I will empower parents to use their ability to decide which schools are best for their kids.

safety.text: Ching supports criminal deterrence, enforcement of laws, and accountability for officials who fail to enforce them.
safety.quote: We must protect our homes, schools, businesses, and neighborhoods from criminals by ways of deterrence.

immigration.text: Ching supports securing the border and enforcing immigration laws against illegal entry and other unlawful movement.
immigration.quote: I will promote legal trade and tourism while supporting ways to best secure our border from the illegal movement of weapons, drugs, contraband, and people.

abortion.text: Ching identifies protecting unborn life as a goal of his congressional campaign.
abortion.quote: As your congressman, I will improve the economy, secure the border, protect our unborn, advocate for education, and defend our constitution.

energy.text: Ching favors an energy approach that prioritizes energy security and limits regulatory effects on industries and businesses rather than aggressive emissions mandates.
energy.quote: Policy statements prioritize economic concerns and energy security over aggressive emissions mandates or phasedown of fossil fuels.
